Try Perplexity Computer (I'm working with Perplexity on this one to give you an honest look): https://ntck.co/perplexity

Perplexity Computer is a $200/month AI system that orchestrates 19 frontier models, runs in the cloud while you sleep, and builds real apps from a single prompt. I built my own AI system — 103 skills, multiple models, AI employees — and didn't want to like it. But after building 7 real projects from my phone in Japan, I have to be honest about what happened.

In this video, you'll learn how Perplexity Computer works under the hood — Firecracker micro VMs, multi-model orchestration, sandboxed sub-agents — and see real projects built from scratch: a gaming website, a cult investigation dashboard, a self-improving Japanese learning app, and more. Whether you're evaluating AI coding tools or looking for the fastest way to turn ideas into real apps, this honest review covers the good, the bad, and the real credit costs.
